moduleName: 英式英语与美式英语的区别

knowledgePoints.title: 一、拼写区别
knowledgePoints.content: 美国人更注重实用性，因此美式英语的拼写比英式英语更简洁。

subPoints.title: 不发音的词尾-me, -ue
subPoints.content:
kilogramme (Br) → kilogram (Am)
programme (Br) → program (Am)
catalogue (Br) → catalog (Am)
dialogue (Br) → dialog (Am)

subPoints.title: 以-our结尾
subPoints.content:
colour (Br) → color (Am)
behaviour (Br) → behavior (Am)
favour (Br) → favor (Am)
flavour (Br) → flavor (Am)
honour (Br) → honor (Am)
labor (Br) → labor (Am)

subPoints.title: 以-re结尾，读音为[ə:]
subPoints.content:
centre (Br) → center (Am)
fibre (Br) → fiber (Am)
metre (Br) → meter (Am)
theatre (Br) → theater (Am)

subPoints.title: 以-ence为结尾
subPoints.content:
defence (Br) → defense (Am)
offence (Br) → offense (Am)
licence (Br) → license (Am)
pretence (Br) → pretense (Am)

subPoints.title: 以-ise结尾的动词
subPoints.content:
criticise (Br) → criticize (Am)
organise (Br) → organize (Am)
realise (Br) → realize (Am)
recognise (Br) → recognize (Am)
standardise (Br) → standardize (Am)

subPoints.title: 双写-ll-拼写
subPoints.content:
councillor (Br) → councilor (Am)
travelling (Br) → traveling (Am)
marvellous (Br) → marvelous (Am)

knowledgePoints.title: 二、同词异义
knowledgePoints.content: 同一个词在英语和美语中可能指不一样的东西

subPoints.title: biscuit
subPoints.content:
英式：软饼、饼干
美式：苏打饼干

subPoints.title: corn
subPoints.content:
英式：谷物、小麦
美式：玉米

subPoints.title: first floor
subPoints.content:
英式：二层
美式：一层

subPoints.title: football
subPoints.content:
英式：足球
美式：橄榄球

subPoints.title: pants
subPoints.content:
英式：内裤
美式：长裤

subPoints.title: purse
subPoints.content:
英式：妇女的小包
美式：手提包

subPoints.title: billion
subPoints.content:
英式：兆
美式：百万兆

knowledgePoints.title: 三、同义异词
knowledgePoints.content: 同一个意思，在英语和美语中分别用不同的词语

subPoints.title: 出租车
subPoints.content: cab (Am) / taxi (Br)

subPoints.title: 大货车
subPoints.content: truck (Am) / lorry (Br)

subPoints.title: 地铁
subPoints.content: subway (Am) / underground/Tube (Br)

subPoints.title: 电梯
subPoints.content: elevator (Am) / lift (Br)

subPoints.title: 电影
subPoints.content: movie (Am) / film (Br)

subPoints.title: 二楼
subPoints.content: 2nd floor (Am) / 1st floor (Br)

subPoints.title: 高速公路
subPoints.content: freeway (Am) / motorway (Br)

subPoints.title: 公寓
subPoints.content: apartment (Am) / flat (Br)

subPoints.title: 股票
subPoints.content: stock (Am) / shares (Br)

subPoints.title: 罐头
subPoints.content: can (Am) / tin (Br)

exercises.question: 英式英语中的 'colour' 在美式英语中写作 ______
美式英语中的 'elevator' 在英式英语中是 ______
在英式英语中，'first floor' 指的是 ______
exercises.explanation: 英式英语的一楼是ground floor，二楼是first floor

exercises.question: 美式英语中的 'movie theater' 对应的英式英语是 ______
exercises.explanation: 英式英语用cinema表示电影院

exercises.question: 英式英语 'trousers' 在美式英语中是 ______
